title: Shadow Puppeteer
description: A man in a black and purple Victorian outfit stands centered with arms outstretched on a red carpet, controlling massive purple tentacles emerging from his back. The tentacles feature a large cat-like mask and interact with a shattered mirror revealing a woman in a floral dress and a translucent ghostly woman in a white gown, surrounded by floating film reels, books, and fairies in a cluttered Victorian room with posters on the walls.
prompt: A dramatic surreal scene of a young man in a black cropped Victorian jacket with purple lining and long black pants standing center with arms spread wide, controlling enormous glowing purple tentacles that emerge from his back. One tentacle ends in a large floating white cat mask with orange eyes. He stands in a cluttered ornate room filled with old film reels, scattered books, posters on the walls, and broken glass. A woman in a floral dress appears inside a shattered mirror behind him while a translucent ghostly woman in a flowing white gown stands to his right, with small glowing fairies flying around, cinematic lighting, rich textures.
